scope: Public GitHub/OpenSource and community/forum evidence for EBYTE non-U M31 Ethernet/RS485 distributed IO. No repository changes, device probes, writes, software execution, or EXE downloads.

classification_policy.communityreported: An inspectable community source reports behavior or implements a mapping. This is not an independent hardware verification by the researcher.
classification_policy.verifiedmanufacturer: Reserved for directly inspected manufacturer evidence. None of the register claims in this report use this category; official manuals are covered by the other research streams.
classification_policy.hypothesis: A register assignment derived from code layout, or an interpretation not backed by a capture or directly reported value.
classification_policy.important: Public non-fork repositories are separately attributable sources, not necessarily independent derivations of the manufacturer manual. Never promote community write calls to device-safe write permission.

sources.evidence_kind: Real Go implementation plus README console outputs, no raw capture
sources.reported_observation: README shows MAC, DHCP disabled, TCP server, IP 192.168.3.7, port 502, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway/DNS 192.168.3.1, 9600 baud, NONE parity; another output shows IP/gateway/DNS changed to 192.168.2.x.
sources.address_convention: Literal zero-based PDU addresses passed to goburrow/modbus. 30000 is a holding-register PDU address 0x7530, NOT a 3xxxx input-reference label; no minus-one adjustment.
sources.access: FC03 read plus FC06 WriteSingleRegister calls for IPv4 settings. Device persistence and permitted firmware/model ranges not independently established.
red_flags: ReadHoldingRegisters(30000,89) requests 178 bytes, but binary.Read Config consumes only 176 bytes/88 registers. Address 30088 is unexplained.
30085 is derived as AddressNegotiationRegister, not save/reset. Layout derivation is not a captured operation.
No firmware version, packet capture, reboot/power-cycle confirmation, reset/save implementation, or exact UDP discovery payload.
SlaveId is assigned from the local slaveId variable before flag.Parse; the README -s 1 invocation does not prove runtime slave=1.
The baud display guard excludes code 8 although the eight-element list includes 230400.
The statement that all configuration parameters are registers is the author's claim, not universal non-U model confirmation.
sources.rank: Strongest available community register source, but not hardware-verified by this research

red_flags: No README, tests, raw response, firmware version or hardware result in the inspected repository.

red_flags: Mock test synthesizes alternating bits; it is not a device capture.

Several model channel counts look like copy/paste errors: AXAX4040G is given 4 AI, AXAX8080G 8 AI, AXXX8000G 8 DO and 8 AI, XAXA0404G has AO=0.

sources.identity_and_discovery: GUI identifies a device and logs a completed search with one device; screenshot has Reboot, Restore and Negotiation buttons. This does not identify the transport or opcode of any of these operations; SerialPort is selected, so it is not UDP discovery evidence.
red_flags: Author explicitly says AI could not be tested because no signal generator/analog device was available; borrowed analog example is not this device's measured AI behavior.
Screenshots bear a CSDN watermark. Original CSDN URL/author not located; provenance/repost lineage remains unknown, so count as one evidence family, not independent duplicates.
Article includes manufacturer promotion and sample/giveaway information; independence from vendor sponsorship is not established.
GUI-reported firmware 1.1 supports only this shown device, not all M31 models or a firmware-register address.
sources.rank: Strongest model+firmware-associated community hardware report, but provides no new register addresses

explicit_unknowns.0x0DAC_3500: No model-specific public community register/code/capture evidence located in bounded searches.
explicit_unknowns.0x1194_4500: No model-specific public community register/code/capture evidence located in bounded searches.
explicit_unknowns.udp_discovery: No public non-U M31 discovery datagram payload, port, opcode, request/response capture or protocol parser located. UDP mode enum is not discovery evidence; inspected GUI screenshot is SerialPort.
explicit_unknowns.identity: README and GUI display MAC/model; no independently established model-ID register/function was located.
explicit_unknowns.firmware_register: Firmware 1.1 visible in the community GUI screenshot, but raw register/address/type/count/function unknown.
explicit_unknowns.save: No identified save opcode/register/value sequence or persistence-after-power-cycle report in inspected community code.
explicit_unknowns.reset_reboot_restore: GUI buttons exist in screenshot, but their underlying registers/commands/values are unknown.
explicit_unknowns.expansion_assignment: No independent GXAAAX4440/GXXXA0008 allocation captures or code located. Do not extrapolate per-slot strides from these sources.
explicit_unknowns.other_models: No hardware-associated register capture located for M31-AXXXA000G, M31-XAXA0404G or the expansion models. HACS dropdown is not measured support.

Search-only configuration-tool download listing, not an inspectable M31 register capture. No binary downloaded.

negative_coverage.qualification: Not found means no usable evidence was located in these bounded public/indexed searches, not proof no post or private implementation exists. Search-engine synthesized examples are not treated as sources.

github_code.qualification: Absence of the literal number does not exclude the field: m31config derives 30085 through struct order.

negative_coverage.candidate_repository_issues_and_discussi: Public issue lists state=all were empty in all three candidate repositories; GitHub metadata has_discussions=false for all three. No separate global Discussion search API was available; broad indexed searches yielded no usable non-U Discussion.
forums_and_community_searches: Exact models on community.home-assistant.io, mikrocontroller.net, plcforum, elektroda.pl, CSDN and cnblogs: no register-specific independent thread located.
Chinese 亿佰特 M31 分布式IO 寄存器 searches including elecfans.com, 51hei.com, amobbs.com, oshwhub.com: manufacturer/LoRa and unrelated MCU content, no additional matching map.
Exact addresses 0x7530, 0x7585, 0x0DAC, 0x1194 and decimal 30000,30085,3500,4500: no usable new forum register capture.
Russian model/Modbus register searches: no usable matching forum report located.
Reddit and English/German/Polish PLC/electronics searches: no usable exact non-U model thread located.
Original CSDN article for watermarked modbus.cn screenshots: not located; repost lineage remains unresolved.
negative_coverage.rejected_search_synthesis: Some web-search summaries invented unattributed 30001/40001 IO examples or incorrectly called literal 30000 an input-register reference. Underlying cited pages did not show those examples. These claims are explicitly excluded.
